accuracy.inputs: N x C probabilities; N integer labels

macro_f1.inputs: predictions and labels; full declared class set
macro_f1.aggregation: equal class mean then seed mean
macro_f1.edge_cases: zero denominator -> class F1=0, not a missing metric; absent classes included

per_class_f1.aggregation: one value per declared class per seed

ece.edge_cases: empty bins have null summaries; confidence=1 included in final bin

nll.edge_cases: zero probability clipped only for log; invalid rows rejected
nll.limitations: sensitive to confident errors; clipping caps loss

brier.interpretation: probabilistic forecast quality, not pure epistemic uncertainty

normalized_entropy.edge_cases: 0 log 0 handled with clipped log; zero contribution
normalized_entropy.limitations: not uncertainty quality; confident wrong predictions can have low entropy

error_detection_auroc.inputs: binary prediction-error labels and per-sample entropy
error_detection_auroc.edge_cases: all correct/all wrong -> null NOT COMPUTED
error_detection_auroc.interpretation: ability of entropy to rank errors
error_detection_auroc.limitations: needs both outcomes and enough errors

stability_ssim.inputs: nonconstant [0,1] attribution maps; fixed clean target; sigma=.05 RGB noise
stability_ssim.normalization: maps min-max; data_range=1; separate from composite
stability_ssim.aggregation: fixed balanced explanation subset then seeds
stability_ssim.edge_cases: constant maps rejected; 7x7 window or smaller odd window
stability_ssim.limitations: stable explanations may still be unfaithful; noise-dependent

deletion_auc.inputs: fixed-target probabilities after absolute-attribution-ranked patch deletion
deletion_auc.aggregation: 20 steps; 16x16 patches; fixed samples then seeds
deletion_auc.edge_cases: actual deleted fractions used; deterministic tie order; positive step and divisible dimensions required
deletion_auc.limitations: mask baseline and shift matter; compare random/least-salient controls; low initial confidence can lower AUC

robustness.inputs: Gaussian noise sigma .05,.1,.2; brightness loss .1,.3,.5; fixed test inputs
robustness.aggregation: equal mean of six conditions then seeds
robustness.edge_cases: unknown corruption/negative severity rejected; missing conditions invalid

silhouette.inputs: L2-normalized penultimate features and class labels; Euclidean distance; a=within-class mean, b=nearest other-class mean
silhouette.limitations: depends on geometry/dimension; not proven transfer quality

composite_trust.formula: sum_i w_i s_i, w_i>=0, sum_i w_i=1
composite_trust.inputs: exactly six finite normalized pillars and versioned weights
composite_trust.normalization: no test-extrema normalization; fixed metric transformations
composite_trust.aggregation: per seed composite then seed statistics
composite_trust.edge_cases: missing/invalid pillar rejects score; no imputation/renormalization
composite_trust.interpretation: transparent utility summary; not Bayesian probability
composite_trust.limitations: subjective weights, correlated pillars, context-specific interpretation

explanation_control_normalized.inputs: salient-first and random-order deletion AUC of the same images/targets/schedule
explanation_control_normalized.normalization: 0.5 = salient deletion no faster than random
explanation_control_normalized.interpretation: attribution faithfulness relative to a random-ranking control
explanation_control_normalized.limitations: POST-HOC diagnostic defined after results were inspected; not part of the pre-declared composite; shares masking-baseline limitations
